data.description: 盛夏微风吹拂的私人泳池畔，莉音身着性感的黑色连体泳衣外搭半透明轻纱，优雅地站在池边俯视着清澈的池水。红瞳微眯——「水温 26 度，风速 1.2 米……一切都是最适合消夏的数值。老师，过来和我一起游两圈吧。」
data.promptProse: Resting beside an illuminated infinity pool on an exclusive high-rise penthouse terrace at dusk, Rio gazes thoughtfully into the crystal water while adjusting the sheer chiffon wrap over her structured black swimsuit. Pale turquoise aquatic light ripples across her pale skin and the dark granite decking, reflecting the quiet, strategic calculations behind her calm composure.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 私人泳池边的缜密思考
data.animaCaption: She studies the pool water as reflections flicker across her cover-up.
